description: This file implements the WriteBuffer class, which manages writing audio data buffers to a GStreamer pipeline in a WebAudio context. It handles buffer allocation, filling, and pushing data to the GStreamer appsrc, with logging and synchronization.

classes.name: WriteBuffer
classes.description: A class responsible for writing audio data buffers to a GStreamer appsrc in a WebAudio context.

methods.name: WriteBuffer::WriteBuffer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the WriteBuffer with context, GStreamer wrapper, and buffer pointers/lengths.

methods.name: WriteBuffer::execute
methods.description: Performs the buffer writing operation, including buffer allocation, filling, pushing to GStreamer, and updating context state.
